newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Quilmes names chairman of mgmt.
newsitem.headline: Quilmes names chairman of mgmt.

text.p: Quilmes Industrial S.A. said on Tuesday that Norberto Morita, the chief executive, had been named chairman of the board of management as part of a plan to reorganize and realign its management structure.
Morita is also a member of the company's board of directors, the company said in a statement.

Meanwhile, Agustin Garcia Mansilla, director of the company's Argentine beverages division, which accounted for more than 60 percent of the company's 1996 sales, has been named vice chairman of the board of management, the company said.
Garcia Mansilla will become chief executive officer of the company on January 1, 1998, when Morita retires from operating management to pursue personal business interests, the company said.
The company's chief financial officer, Gerardo Barretto, has also been named to the board of management, the company added.
Quilmes Industrial is a Luxembourg-based holding company that controls 85 percent of Quilmes International Ltd.
